title: Welcome to GifOS
lead: Your own computer that lives in your browser. No account, no installs — and everything you make is a file you keep.
card.gif.title: Every app is a GIF
card.gif.body: Those animated icons on your Home Screen are real GIF images — with a whole app tucked inside. Double-click one and it runs. Send one to a friend and they get your app with your stuff in it.
card.stays.title: Your stuff stays put
card.stays.body: Whatever you do in an app is saved with its icon automatically. Close the tab, come back tomorrow — you're right where you left off. Nothing is stored on anyone's servers.
card.together.title: Play together with one link
card.together.body: Open any app and press Invite. Send the link to friends and they join you live — same game, same notes, same room. Try Meeting, right on your Home Screen — you can even run an app inside it!
card.irl.title: Games for real-life hangouts
card.irl.body: The IRL Games folder is for game night: everyone keeps their own phone — open a game, press Invite, and secret roles, hidden votes, and sneaky lies get dealt to each player's screen while the laughing and accusing happens face to face. Only one phone in the room? The Single Phone subfolder has pass-around versions.
card.make.title: Make your own apps
card.make.body: Press ＋ Add in the top bar, copy the magic prompt into any AI (like Claude), tell it what you want, and paste back what it gives you. You just made an app. It's yours to keep.
card.change.title: Change any app
card.change.body: Every app is yours — free to keep, free to pass on, free to modify and improve. Hand the GIF to any AI and ask for a change. It unpacks what's inside, edits it, and packs it back. You don't need to know how to code.
card.steal.title: Or just steal one
card.steal.body: See an app you like in a friend's session or a call? Press Steal and choose where the copy goes — your Stolen Apps chest or a downloaded GIF — and how much comes with it: No data for a fresh, empty copy, or the data as it arrived or as it is now to carry the game in progress or the shared notes. Anyone in the session can, since it's already synced to your browser. It's not rude here, it's the whole point: every app is a file, so taking one just copies the GIF. Then remix it with your AI and make it yours.
card.backup.title: Your whole computer is one file
card.backup.body: GifOS menu (top-left) → Back up Home Screen gives you a single GIF holding everything. Keep it safe, or double-click it anywhere to boot your computer — even inside another one.
try.title: See the magic for yourself
try.body: Check something off, close this tab, then open Welcome again — it remembers. That's your data living inside the icon.
magic: Now close this tab and reopen Welcome from your desktop 😉
